name: whatsapp
description: WhatsApp connector — send text messages and templates via the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API

ai.insodimension.dimension.title: WhatsApp
examples: Text me on WhatsApp when the build finishes
Send the hello_world template to +14155552671 on WhatsApp
Message +44 7700 900123 on WhatsApp: running 10 minutes late

setup.title: Create a Meta app (type Business)
setup.detail: Sign in at Meta for Developers → My Apps → Create App → choose the "Business" type. Any name works, e.g. "Dimension WhatsApp".

setup.title: Add the WhatsApp product to the app
setup.detail: On the app dashboard, find "WhatsApp" and click Set up. Meta gives you a FREE test phone number to send from — no billing or approved business number required to start.

setup.title: Copy the Phone number ID and an access token
setup.detail: Open WhatsApp → API Setup. Copy the "Phone number ID" and the temporary access token shown there. The temporary token expires after 24 hours — for permanent use, create a System User token in Business Settings → Users → System Users (assign it the whatsapp_business_messaging permission).

setup.title: Add your own phone as a test recipient
setup.detail: Still on API Setup, add the phone number you want to message under "To". Test numbers can only send to up to 5 recipients you register here, and each must reply once to open the messaging window.

setup.title: Paste the access token and Phone number ID below
setup.detail: Both stay on this machine — nothing is sent to Dimension's servers.

form.label: Access token
form.help: From WhatsApp → API Setup. The temporary token dies after 24 hours — for permanent use paste a System User token created in Meta Business Settings instead.

form.label: Phone number ID
form.help: The numeric Phone number ID from WhatsApp → API Setup — NOT the display phone number itself.

failures.match: OAuthException|Error validating access token|Session has expired|expired
failures.title: Reconnect WhatsApp — the access token is invalid or expired
failures.detail: Temporary tokens die after 24 hours. Create a permanent System User token in Meta Business Settings, or copy a fresh temporary one from API Setup.

tools.name: whatsapp_send_message
tools.description: Send a free-form text WhatsApp message. Only reaches people who messaged your number in the last 24h; otherwise use a template.

tools.name: whatsapp_send_template
tools.description: Send a pre-approved WhatsApp template — required for first contact or outside the 24-hour customer-service window.

tools.name: whatsapp_send_image
tools.description: Send an image from a public HTTPS URL (with optional caption). Like text, media only reaches people who messaged your number in the last 24h.

tools.name: whatsapp_send_document
tools.description: Send a document/file from a public HTTPS URL (with optional filename + caption). Like text, media only reaches people who messaged your number in the last 24h.
